[USER] The user asked for tips on how to choose the right type of asparagus for roasting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for choosing asparagus for roasting, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Prefer thicker asparagus spears (about 1/2 inch or 1 cm in diameter).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Look for fresh asparagus with tightly closed buds and no signs of woody or soggy stems.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Asparagus is typically in season from February to June, with peak season being April and May.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Recommended varieties include Jersey Knights, Purple Flare, and Pacific Purple.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a method for testing asparagus freshness by bending the spear.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised on proper storage of asparagus in a damp paper towel in a plastic bag in the refrigerator.
